pins.description: Official CUDA 13 SGLang nightly base image, pinned by digest.
SGLang commit the base image was built from.
SGLang main commit checked out in the image.
Tree of the SGLang main commit, before the patch.
Final SGLang tree in the image, after the single source patch.
SGLang PR #29927 head included in the source patch.
sgl-project/sglang#32183: propagate the runtime DSpark verifier width into the DeepSeek-V4 compressed-state planner instead of the hardcoded kMaxMTPDraftTokens = 4 rewrite window.
SGLang PR #33614 head included in the source patch.
SGLang PR #32194 head included in the source patch.
SGLang PR #30700 head included in the source patch.
SGLang PR #32330 rebased local head included in the source patch, adding the mnnvl preflight multicast-granularity fix.
SGLang PR #32686 head included in the source patch.
SGLang PR #32815 head included in the source patch.
SGLang PR #33616 (FlashInfer mHC fusion for DSV4), merged upstream; pinned head carried here.
SGLang PR #33518 (sglext_spec: per-request speculative statistics on the OpenAI endpoints).
Local fix: enable the SM120 DeepGEMM capability when the required grouped FP4 symbol is installed.
Local fix: size the FlashInfer all-reduce workspace for the largest configured prefill forward.
Local fix: admit SM120 through the all-reduce execution gate for the backend enabled by PR #32330.
Local fix: bound the allreduce-only kAllReduce path by the same token cap as the fused path, so prefill-sized all-reduces use NCCL.
Local fix: run SWA window eviction on the dflash/dspark speculative decode path, so a single request is no longer retracted at swa_full_tokens_ratio x max_total_num_tokens generated tokens.
FlashInfer main commit the Python wheel is built from.
Tree of the FlashInfer main commit, before the patch.
FlashInfer tree after the single source patch, as built into the wheel.
FlashInfer PR #4308 head included in the source patch.
FlashInfer PR #4380 (consolidated DSV4 sparse MLA top-k 192/256 support).
FlashInfer PR #4393 (pcie_ipc all-reduce for intra-node PCIe machines).
FlashInfer version of both the built Python wheel and the cubin wheel.
Prebuilt cubin wheel matching the FlashInfer version.
SHA256 of the cubin wheel, enforced by the installer.

patches.description: SGLang PRs #29927, #33614, #32194, #30700, #32330 (rebased), #32686, #32815, #32183, #33616 and #33518 at the heads pinned above, five local fixes, the DSV4/DSV32 tool-schema encoding fix, and a local consumer for FlashInfer PR #4393's pcie_ipc all-reduce.
FlashInfer PRs #4308, #4380 and #4393 at the heads pinned above.

verification.note: Applying the SGLang patch to DSV4_0731_SGLANG_MAIN_HEAD yields DSV4_0731_SGLANG_EFFECTIVE_TREE. Applying the FlashInfer patch to DSV4_0731_FLASHINFER_MAIN_HEAD yields DSV4_0731_FLASHINFER_EFFECTIVE_TREE.
